event.title: Tween Dungeons and Dragons
event.description: Please see contact information to receive information on registration and future Tween Dungeons and Dragons sessions. Join our quest for valor! Kids ages 9-12 are invited to register for our Winter Session of Tween Dungeons and Dragons. Our Winter Session is designed for players already familiar with the basics of the game. Don't know how to play? Connect with us for our next Introduction to Dungeons and Dragons for Tweens Session starting in early 2027. Our Winter Session meets every other week from 3:30-5:00, for four meetings total. We meet on the following dates: Nov. 4; Nov. 18; Dec. 2; Dec. 16. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.
event.blurb: Play Dungeons and Dragons with other kids ages 9-12 in the library's Winter Session, with registration handled through the listed contact.
event.attendanceNote: We're sorry, this event is full. Contact Librarian Charlie Roos to be added to a waitlist for future sessions: charlie.roos@lib.sccgov.org.
